messages:
Priya Desai: Quick heads up — candidate for ML Infra (onsite) moved to hybrid. First two interviews onsite, last two remote. Can folks confirm panel coverage and who will scribe? Also flag any accessibility needs. Zoom fallback link is already on the event.
Samir Patel: I can cover 10:00–10:45 onsite and scribe if needed. @Elena can you take the remote block? :+1:
Elena Gomez: I can take remote. Would prefer using the standard debrief template — can someone paste the link? Quick rubric Q: for system design, are we still scoring 1–5 or switching to 1–10 for this loop?
Priya Desai: We use 1–5 across the board for consistency. Weighting for this role: technical design 40%, coding 35%, role fit 25%. I'll add that to the event notes.
Aisha K.: Candidate asked for live captions and prefers a quieter room for onsite. Can Facilities/ops ensure meeting room has captioning or we'll use Google Meet captions? Also any food allergies noted for lunch?
Samir Patel: No allergies on candidate profile. I'll book a quieter room and enable captions. Scribe rotation suggestion: Samir (first onsite), Priya (second onsite), Elena (remote).
Priya Desai: Nice — I added scribe rotation to event title. Also please paste the debrief doc link where we'll capture scores + notes.
Elena Gomez: Pasting template below — please use this for notes and tick the checklist after debrief:
```
Debrief doc: https://notion.redwood/internals/interviews/ml-infra-debrief
Checklist:
- Notes (bullet per round)
- Scores (1-5, per rubric)
- Consent for transcript (yes/no)
- Action: hire/no-hire/more-info
```
Samir Patel: @PeopleOps Bot can you schedule a reminder 15 minutes before the first onsite slot and include scribe tags? Also set a 30m post-interview debrief block for interviewers.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: 15 minutes before interview start. Scribes logged: Samir Patel, Priya Desai, Elena Gomez. Post-interview debrief block created for 30m. Event note link: https://notion.redwood/internals/interviews/ml-infra-debrief :white_check_mark:
Priya Desai: Thanks all — if anyone can't make their slot ping here and we'll reassign. Otherwise, see you tomorrow.
Elena Gomez: All set from my side. See you tomorrow. :wave:
Aisha K.: All good — I'll confirm room ops are aware of captioning.
Samir Patel: I'll bring a laptop for scribe and drop a quick checklist in the doc before the interview starts.
Priya Desai: Closing thread — final reminder will come from PeopleOps Bot. Appreciate the quick turns.
